GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (6 Aug 47) GA
(SCAPIN - 1750/1)
APO 500
6 August 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of German and Austrian Nationals.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum from the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file AG 014.33 (21 Jul 47)GA (SCAPIN 1750), dated 21 July 1947, subject as above, and Inclosure 1 thereto.
2. Part III, Inclosure 1 (Nominal Rolls of Non-objectionable German and Austrian Nationals Desiring Repatriation) of reference paragraph 1 above, is amended by the addition of the German and Austrian Nationals listed on nominal rolls forwarded herewith.
3. Subject personnel will be processed as directed for those repatriates previously listed in reference paragraph 1 above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
